rule: Every loop is owned and closed by a server-side worker. A client session (a code agent, a chat, a person's machine) is only ever a producer of work; it never completes, merges, deploys, resolves, archives or files the follow-up for a loop. The worker that dispatched or created the work owns verifying and closing it.
owner_directive: Rowan, 2026-11-13: close all open loops autonomously and server side; client side agents never complete loops; server side agents own the loops they create.
executor_role: A code agent is a producer. The dispatching worker records the dispatch, verifies the result through an independent path and closes (merge when green, retry, or a tracked item with owner, trigger and probe).
